paragraphs.text:
You hear a whirring sound. Something bangs into your shins 
and yanks your feet from beneath you. A bolas! You hit the 
ground face-first. The little men seize you, bind you, and carry 
you away.

Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 263; if the result is odd, go 
to 265.
